_help: Linux/macOS version — see comsol-mph.windows.json for the Windows (PowerShell) equivalent. COMSOL .mph files are zip archives; models saved with a thumbnail (all COMSOL Application Library samples, and user models whose thumbnail was set) carry modelimage_large.png (1024x768) and modelimage.png inside. This extracts the large one, falling back to the small one, using unzip -p (streams just that one entry out of the zip's central directory, no full extraction) - no extra tools beyond unzip, which ships on virtually every Linux distro. Models saved without a thumbnail simply keep the file icon. Waydir ignores every key starting with "_".
_help_args: %INPUT%/%OUTPUT% are passed as $1/$2 (separate argv entries after the "sh" placeholder for $0), not interpolated into the script string, so paths with spaces or quotes are safe. unzip exits non-zero when neither entry is found, which Waydir correctly reads as failure (falls back to the icon) even though the redirect still creates an empty %OUTPUT% file first. Remote (sftp://) files can't be read by unzip and also fall back to the icon.
